subject: Mutual action plan: Dedicated capacity sizing for BlueHarbor (traffic questionnaire + runbook ask)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@blueharbor.ai>, Samantha Ling <samantha.ling@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: Dedicated capacity sizing for BlueHarbor (traffic questionnaire + runbook ask)

Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our MPA I'm attaching a short pre-sales sizing worksheet (redwood-pre-sales-sizer.xlsx) to capture the traffic signals our Dedicated team needs to propose an optimal GPU mix and burst strategy. If you can populate the sheet or paste the items below we'll use it to provide a committed + burst plan and a recommended canary/rollout runbook.

High-level asks (rough is fine):
- Workload flavor: chat assistance + summarization + retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Average concurrent active sessions (sessions that will hold KV cache) and 95/99th concurrent peaks
- Typical prompt token length (median) and typical generated token length (median/90th) by feature (chat / summarization / RAG)
- Request rate distribution: sustained qps vs short spikes (e.g., 10m window every X hours)
- Session duration distribution (avg/90th) and session affinity expectations (sticky or stateless)
- Percent of requests requiring long context (>= 8k tokens) vs short contexts
- SLA targets (p95 latency, error budget) and acceptable fallback model if committed capacity is saturated
- Any compliance/retention constraints (KV cache persistence, audit logs)

Quick example answers you can copy:
- Average concurrency: 120 active sessions; 95th: 420; peak burst (10m): 1,600
- Prompt length (chat median): 45 tokens; response median: 280 tokens; 90th resp: 620 tokens
- Mix: chat 65%, RAG 25%, batch summarization 10%
- SLA p95: 450ms for short chat responses; for RAG allowed up to 1.2s

If helpful, propose two workshop slots this week for a 45-minute traffic deep-dive so the capacity team can run quick sizing runs and deliver a committed + burst recommendation (with GPU SKU mix and estimated monthly committed cost). Also, I’ve included a link to our standard preflight checklist so you know what telemetry we’ll ask for.

Attached: redwood-pre-sales-sizer.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Karthik into the sizing once you send the telemetry sample.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@blueharbor.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ling <samantha.ling@blueharbor.ai>, procurement <procurement@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Dedicated capacity sizing for BlueHarbor (traffic questionnaire + runbook ask)

Jordan —

Thanks — appreciated. I filled out the key points inline below and attached a sample of last month's telemetry (blueharbor-telemetry-sample.csv). Let me know if you need raw traces.

Inline answers:
- Workload: chat assistant for customer support (primary), plus nightly summarization batch jobs and RAG (search + generate) for knowledge base answers.
- Concurrency: sustained 140 active sessions during business hours; typical 95th: 520. We see multi-day campaign spikes with sustained higher baselines.
- Peaks: short spikes up to ~1,800 concurrent sessions for ~8-12 minutes (hourly during promos).
- Prompt/response lengths: chat prompts median ~38 tokens; chat responses median ~320 tokens; 95th response ~900 tokens. RAG flows regularly return 600–1,200 tokens when long-doc answers are required.
- Session duration/affinity: avg session 5.5 minutes; 90th ~22 minutes. We use sticky sessions for KV cache to maintain chat state.
- Percent long context: ~12% of requests need >=8k token context (multi-doc search).
- SLA: p95 latency target: 600ms for chat quick responses; acceptable fallback to smaller model for non-critical reads.
- Retention / compliance: KV cache retained for 30 days, logs retained for 1 year. SOC 2 in progress; will share certs via procurement channel.

Attachments: blueharbor-telemetry-sample.csv

We can do a workshop on Thu 23 May 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 24 May 14:00–14:45 PT. Thu works best for our infra lead.

— Alex
Alex Perez
Head of ML Infrastructure, BlueHarbor
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan: Dedicated capacity sizing for BlueHarbor (traffic questionnaire + runbook ask)

Marissa / Karthik —

FYI BlueHarbor returned their telemetry and proposed a Thu workshop. Key signals (see attachment):
- Sustained concurrency: 140; 95th: 520; short peak up to 1,800 for 8–12 minutes
- Prompt/resp medians: prompt ~38 tokens; resp median ~320 tokens; 95th resp ~900 tokens
- 12% long-context (>=8k tokens) use; sticky sessions required; KV cache retention 30d
- SLA p95 target 600ms for chat quick responses

Asks: can you run a quick rough-sizing note for a committed fleet + burst pool (target: meet p95 600ms, cost-conscious) and recommend:
1) GPU SKU mix (e.g., A100-80GB vs H100-80GB or quantized variants) for committed cores and burst nodes
2) Suggested burst pool size to cover 99.9% of typical promo spikes without throttling (we can accept brief fallbacks for ultra-peaks)
3) Canary rollout plan: suggested shadow run ratio and ramp schedule

Please drop a 1-page note in the HubSpot deal (link below) ahead of the workshop so we can walk the recommendation with BlueHarbor. I’ve attached their telemetry sample and our preflight checklist.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
Attachments: blueharbor-telemetry-sample.csv, redwood-pre-sales-sizer.xlsx

Thanks — Jordan
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perez <alex.perez@blueharbor.ai>, Samantha Ling <samantha.ling@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 21:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Dedicated capacity sizing for BlueHarbor (traffic questionnaire + runbook ask)

Alex / Samantha —

Thanks for the telemetry and the slot. Thu 23 May 10:00 PT works for our infra lead — we’ll run the sizing live and share a 1-page committed + burst recommendation during the call.

Prep for the workshop (short):
- Please confirm the telemetry time-range (the file looks like one month; good), and grant read access to one S3 bucket or a zipped manifest if there are larger logs.
- Loop your infra lead on the invite (we need someone who knows how sessions are pinned and where KV cache is hosted).
- Confirm whether any of the peak traffic is synthetic (campaign) vs organic — that helps sizing the burst pool.

I’ve uploaded a first-draft MPA runbook and our preflight checklist to the shared drive and attached cropped PDFs for quick reference: blueharbor-mpa-v1.pdf, redwood-dedicated-preflight-checklist.pdf. During the session we’ll: 1) validate the telemetry, 2) run a rapid sizing pass, 3) agree on a canary and rollback policy.

If procurement needs a template SOW or pricing table ahead of the workshop, we can include a preliminary cost estimate (non-binding).

Calendar invite incoming — see you Thu.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: blueharbor-mpa-v1.pdf, redwood-dedicated-preflight-checklist.pdf
